source: Pinned original LeRobot releases relabeled from approved host 200 episode/slice annotations; all published metadata, data and video hashes verified after HF download and archived to S3.
duration_definition: Frames divided by FPS on the trajectory timeline; cameras and sampling repeats are not multiplied. Trainable frames have is_for_training=true.
normalization_status: Reused existing normalization only after all published state/action values and training-start flags were proven identical to the original pinned datasets.

launch_requirements: Before any launch, reverify current dataset heads and all metadata/data/video hashes, pin the verified revisions, and comply with the target host training contract. No GPU training was started during preparation.
data_split_policy: All 150 episodes assigned to train by owner request; no validation or test set.
tail_policy: All frames retained in export; existing last-50-frame exclusion applies only to training starts. No stage-boundary truncation or masking added.
